corrections.basis: The secondary #0 record explicitly names MarvelUnlimitedID 98662 and April 20, 2022 release, followed by Symbol of Truth #1 and Sentinel of Liberty #1. The provider returns this exact ID and date, number 0, under the 2018 series with no issue number in its title. The checklist keeps #0; no #1 or earlier zero issue is substituted.

The secondary issue record explicitly names MarvelUnlimitedID 64178, August 9, 2017 release, and predecessors Sam Wilson #24 and Steve Rogers #19. Provider issue 64178 has that release date and Nick Spencer writer credit. The supplied 2017 series 23277 contains #695-704, not this unified #25.

The secondary 15AU record explicitly names MarvelUnlimitedID 45879, May 8, 2013 release and Al Ewing writer. Provider issue 45879 agrees on date and writer but numbers the original #15. Preserve the AU source label with a reviewed exact-number translation, not blind suffix stripping.
